backup_title: UCR Summary of Reported Crimes in the Nation, 2024
use_rule: Use CIUS tables 1-7 and related CIUS trend resources when V2 needs official FBI annual estimates or same-agency trend outputs.
do_not_use_for: raw universe counts; ORI reporting-status logic
guardrail: Do not compare CIUS estimates/trends directly to raw NIBRS incident files without first converting the question into the same methodology lane.
why: RCN 2024 confirms that CIUS is the publication component containing estimated and trended outputs.

preferred_title: Crime in the United States Annual Reports
use_rule: Use CIUS tables 8-11 for published city, university, county, and state/tribal/other agency counts.
do_not_use_for: missing-agency backfilling from roster or participation counts inside the same lane
guardrail: These tables only contain agencies submitting 12 months of complete offense data; DDT is for explanation, not replacement.
why: The official CDE discovery page labels tables 8-11 as the published 2024 agency tables and states the 12-month completeness rule.

use_rule: Use the explorer and DDT for current monitoring, spike investigation, and interactive lookups.
guardrail: Snapshot the timestamp externally if you must cite the dynamic surface; monthly values can move and publication pauses occur during annual release processing.
why: The explorer is explicitly dynamic and uses mixed summarized methodologies for some offense families.

preferred_title: Agency Roster by State Abbreviation Endpoint
use_rule: Use the public roster endpoint for ORI, agency type, county grouping, current NIBRS status, and nibrs_start_date; use DDT for spot-checking names and agency presence.
do_not_use_for: crime totals or automatic 2024 source policy without start-date logic
guardrail: Convert current is_nibrs to effective_nibrs_2024 using nibrs_start_date <= 2024-12-31 before making year-specific regime decisions.
why: The packet-local roster extract shows 481 agencies with is_nibrs=true but a start date after 2024-12-31.

preferred_title: Uniform Crime Reporting Program Participation Data
use_rule: Use participation data for state-year agency counts and population-coverage context across the SRS-to-NIBRS transition.
do_not_use_for: ORI roster validation; offense totals; CIUS table reconstruction
guardrail: This dataset counts agencies reporting in any format and is meant to clarify population coverage, not to identify the roster of agencies eligible for a specific publication table.
why: The FBI participation panel states the any-format coverage purpose directly.

use_rule: Use state NIBRS downloads when V2 needs incident/offense/victim/property detail or ORI-level support.
do_not_use_for: publication-style controls spanning the SRS era
guardrail: Expect differences from CIUS tables and DDT violent/property counts because those surfaces apply different summarization and hierarchy rules.
why: The state downloads preserve raw NIBRS detail instead of publication-table or hierarchy-rule summaries.

use_rule: Use annual master files when V2 needs bulk raw continuity across older UCR collections or wants the full in-file reported universe.
guardrail: Master files require programming extraction and retain all reported data in file, which is a different lane from the publication tables.
why: The CDE methodology page explicitly aligns CDE/open-data behavior with the historical master-file methodology.

backup_title: Crime in the United States Annual Reports
use_rule: Use FBI historical publications through 2019, then CIUS annual bundles in CDE/RCN for 2020+ publication-style continuity.
guardrail: Keep the entire series in the publication lane; do not splice in master/open-data counts as if they were the same series.
why: This preserves the published-table methodology across the FBI site migration to CDE.

use_rule: Use the BJS API for national estimate tables in machine workflows; use CKLE for the official publication rendering and reliability context.
guardrail: Choose current endpoints for latest revised values and archive endpoints for exact originally published prior-year values.
why: The API documentation explicitly separates current revised endpoints from archive endpoints.

use_rule: Use FBI-hosted NIBRS estimation tables when V2 needs static download bundles from the CDE surface rather than the BJS API.
do_not_use_for: legacy CIUS estimate continuity or raw reported totals
guardrail: Treat these tables as part of the NIBRS-estimate family developed with BJS, not as a continuation of the SRS-based CIUS estimate series.
why: The CDE download page says the methods were developed in collaboration with BJS.

preferred_title: Methodologies Explain Potential Differences in UCR Data
backup_title: UCR Summary of Reported Crimes in the Nation, 2024
use_rule: Read these docs before reconciling mismatched official counts from two different surfaces.
guardrail: First classify a surface as reported, estimated, trended, raw/open-data, or dynamic query before labeling a difference as an error.
why: Most false discrepancies come from mixing methodology lanes rather than from data corruption.
